title: Trump Bars CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House
detail: President Trump announced Sept. 18 that he was banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, citing what he called "FAKE NEWS" and "FICTION and LIES" coverage. Reporters from all three outlets were turned away from White House grounds starting Saturday, Sept. 19, and Trump warned other outlets could follow.

media.caption: Trump announces ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
